Visit our website to help give these animals a fighting chance! Link Below 👇

At The Goat Pen Animal Sanctuary, we passionately rescue and nurture rural and farm animals in need, providing them a haven and a second chance at life. Our petting zoo offers a unique and safe experience for children to bond with and feed these wonderful creatures, allowing for joyous memories to be made. We strive to uplift moods, foster education, and promote conscious living through our adoptions, enlightening programs, and curated retail offerings. We believe in the power of human-animal connections to inspire happiness, understanding, and change, one animal and one smile at a time.
